name: AWEI T62 ENC  True Wireless Earphone  Double MIC (  6 Month Official Warranty )
description:
Experience immersive sound and crystal-clear calls with the Awei T62 ENC True Wireless Earphones. Designed for music lovers and professionals alike, these earbuds deliver premium performance in a sleek, compact design.

🎶 Key Features:

Bluetooth Version: 5.3 – Stable connection and low latency.

ENC Technology: Reduces background noise for clear calls and audio.

Battery Life: 6 hours (earbuds) + 20 hours (charging case).

Charging Time: 1.5 hours (earbuds) | 2 hours (case).

Range: Up to 10 meters for wireless freedom.

Water Resistance: IPX5 – Resistant to sweat and light rain, perfect for workouts.

Touch Controls: Easy music playback, calls, and voice assistant activation.

Audio Drivers: High-fidelity dynamic drivers for rich, powerful sound.

Color Options: Elegant Black finish.

📦 Package Includes:

1 × Awei T62 Earbuds

1 × Charging Case

1 × USB Charging Cable

1 × User Manual
